segments.ne1:1.1: Yaṃ loko pūjayate, salokapālo sadā namassati ca;
segments.ne1:2.1: Dvādasa padāni suttaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ byañjanañca attho ca;
segments.ne1:2.3: Taṃ viññeyyaṃ ubhayaṃ, ko attho byañjanaṃ katamaṃ.
segments.ne1:4.1: Hārā byañjanavicayo, suttassa nayā tayo ca suttattho;
segments.ne1:5.1: Yā ceva desanā yañca, desitaṃ ubhayameva viññeyyaṃ;
